notes.title: Update #3 - The Ghost Update
notes.content:
[img]http://www.phatphrogstudios.com/UPDATE3.png[/img]

A new update has been applied, this update adds 8 difficult new achievements you can unlock. 

To unlock these achievements you need to use all your ammunition in a duel without being hit or hitting the enemy, so you must both have full health after a duel

Also added 4 more Most Wanted achievements

Thanks for your support

notes.title: Update #2 - The Speedrunner Update
notes.content:
[img]http://www.phatphrogstudios.com/UPDATE2.png[/img]

A new update has been applied, this update adds 8 difficult new achievements you can unlock. 

To unlock these achievements you have to beat each enemy on hard mode within 8 rounds. 

There have been 16 new achievements added today and lot's more to come!

Hotfixes: 
There is now a restart button on each level so you can quickly restart if you're fighting a losing battle or achievement hunting!

Thanks for your support

notes.title: How to play!
notes.content:
Hey Guys

So to avoid any confusion, this is how Clickdraw works

When you play against the AI, the boxes at the top are the locations that the enemy can move to when you draw your gun and the boxes at the bottom are the spaces you can move too

If the enemy picks the same square you selected to move to when you draw then you will get hit and vice versa

If you get hit 3 times or lose all your ammunition then you lose and vice versa if the enemy gets hit 3 times then you will win, some enemies use body armour to make it more difficult

Hope you have fun!

Thanks for your support ːsquirtyayː
